description: Cost optimization + reliability suggestions for an app: idle apps to archive, memory pressure needing an upgrade, over-provisioned plans that could downgrade, and deploy-regression warnings. Use proactively during check-ins ('is everything fine with my apps?'), when the user asks about their bill, or when they're thinking about cleaning up. Returns { insights[], summary } sorted critical > warning > info. For plan changes suggested by this tool, follow up with percher_billing (action='upgrade' or 'portal') to hand the user a one-click URL. Read-only.
name: percher_app_insights
